compareDisposition.rationale: The curator examined Angels obey the voice of the heavenly king beside Angels and the heavenly army praise their creator; The prayer places an angelic army before the throne; The tempter quotes angelic protection and angels serve Jesus; Angels serve Jesus in Mark’s wilderness scene.
